editorial.name: Lokuma
editorial.descriptionZh: AI 建站工具，输入业务描述后按行业生成设计感较强的站点，强调排版、层级与配色；站内另有一整组免费的品牌与文案小工具。
editorial.takeawayZh: 描述业务生成站点，再去 Free Tools 拿配色和字体搭配
editorial.noteZh: 最上面一条紫底细横幅写着 Lokuma Website Builder 2.0 is here for everyone，下面深色大字标题是 AI Website Builder for Beautiful, Launch-Ready Sites，输入框占位文案是 Describe your business (e.g. A minimal coffee shop in Brooklyn...)。左侧导航把行业一路铺开，Art & Design、Health & Beauty、Professional Services 一直到 Tech & SaaS，另起一组 Free Tools 分四类共 15 个，从 Color Palette Generator、Font Pairing Tool、OG Image Generator 排到 Invoice Generator。再往下 See what you can create with Lokuma 挂了六张示例站，Beauty Studio、Neighborhood Bistro、Studio Agency、Peak Fitness、Harbor Estates、Atelier Goods。

reasons.statement: 首屏输入业务描述后生成、定制、发布整站（Generate, customize, and publish polished, design-forward websites），交付物是整个站点。
站内按行业拆出 14 条 /website-builder/* 落地页与 6 个可用模板 demo，说明成品是成套站点而非组件。
